status: Interface build passed; the six ARMv7 engine libraries are unchanged. The receiver screen leaves for the home screen 0.6 s after sharing ends, driven by the engine's own events; the interface follows PureTV's current look; library resources are limited to English and Turkish and unused resources are removed (versionCode 41). On a Mi Stick / Android TV 9 on 2026-11-14 the production-signed APK was installed, its screens and start/stop were checked, and the device owner confirmed the quick return to the home screen after ending Screen Mirroring on an iPhone. PureTV v1.4 carries this APK as an asset.

previous.status: Interface build passed; the six ARMv7 engine libraries are byte-identical to 0.0.36-puretv.2. Mirrored video is decoded straight into the display surface (GL pipeline as fallback), frames are released as soon as they are decoded, the receiver is named PureTV (earlier installs renamed once), and PureTV can switch Start server at boot (Keep AirPlay on). Switching it from PureTV was checked on the Mi Stick with the production-signed APKs. When the last sender stops sharing, the receiver screen goes to the home screen (versionCode 40). On a Mi Stick / Android TV 9 on 2026-10-29 it was started and stopped from PureTV quick settings (no idle wake lock), the device owner confirmed Screen Mirroring from an iPhone, and the production-signed APK registered as PureTV over a receiver previously named Mi-Stick.

Interface build passed; the six ARMv7 engine libraries are byte-identical to 0.0.36-puretv.1. On-demand start and the 15-minute idle stop were checked on a Mi Stick with a test key on 2026-10-28, as were the PureTV light/dark layout and the idle wake-lock behaviour (none on demand, held with start at boot, released when stopped); a sender connection was not part of the check. Signed with PureTV v1.1's key (certificate SHA-256 808dd32ee3d027606fbaa586c71755ae2e97957182d7f565f8c777db15c93677) and installed beside PureTV v1.1 on the Mi Stick on 2026-10-28.
